page.overview:
Who is Edna?

Edna is a character played by Marisha Ray in the alternate universe of Vox Moronica's campaign in .

Edna is inspired by (but canonically distinct from) the "old lady" NPC that travelled with the Broker in and was killed by Tiberius Stormwind.

Edna would go on to travel with The Broker and encounter the adventure group Vox Machina, where she would meet her death at the hands of Tiberius Stormwind.
